address: Firuzağa Mahallesi, Çukur Cuma Caddesi No:53/A, Beyoğlu, Istanbul, 34425, Türkiye

tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: A stroll through the trendy Çukurcuma neighbourhood, which is famous for its antique shops, should certainly include a meal at Cuma. At this cosy establishment – be sure to secure a spot on the front terrace – you can tuck into a traditional Turkish breakfast or Mediterranean-style lunch or dinner. Seasonal ingredients are showcased brilliantly in tapas such as sea bass ceviche, generously topped pizzettas, aromatic pasta dishes etc. The chef places special emphasis on vegetarian dishes, such as mushroom skewers and halloumi cheese with braised onion, pomegranate and deep-fried polenta. Everyone is sure to find something to their liking here, and at great value for money!
